description.value: You may rig a machine to explode as an action. Choose a single mechanical device that could be conceivably rigged to explode (GM discretion). When anyone activates the machine, it explodes, forcing every character within 3m to suffer 6d6 damage (Dexterity save for half damage, DC 8 + Intelligence modifier + Proficiency bonus). A DC 20 Perception check is required to notice this trap.
